notes.title: Update Notes for 0.9.5e - Engine Upgrade, and More!
notes.notes:
Epocria has been updated from Unity 2019 all the way to Unity 2022. This gives us access to some newer features (which have been used in this update), but could also cause bugs, so if you notice any new bugs please report them!

[list]
[*] Upgraded from Unity 2019.4.15f1 to Unity 2022.3.11f1
[*] UI Button 'hitboxes' have been fixed. This was a long standing bug where the game would think you pressed the wrong button
[*] Chunk initialization has been redone. (This could cause some issues so please let me know if any occur). It should optimize some stuff as well as fix some stuff.
[*] Ground now uses the Unity tileset, should add a bunch of optimization
[*] Wraith can no longer go through objects
[*] Spectre can now go through objects
[*] Fire Flower added, spawns in deserts. Gives 5+ health as an accessory, stacks up to 3 for +15 health.
[*] Cave Crates added, spawn in caves and drop potions! A useful and easy way to avoid crafting them.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 0.9.5d - Dashing, Swords, & More
notes.notes:
Although this update is a small version number change (0.9.5c -> 0.9.5d) it has a bunch of features included as well as bug fixes!

[b]Dash Ability[/b]
Player dashing has been added to quickly  get out of danger. As long as you have an item (or effect) that gives you the dash ability you'll be able to dash.

[list]
[*] The momentum potion has been made to also give you the ability to dash while active
[*] Hermes Cloak has been added. 5% speed boost, however, it gives you the ability to dash while equipped.
[*] Hermes Cloak drops rarely from bats (happy grinding!)
[/list]

[b]Sword Balancing[/b]
Swords have been completely rebalanced and sped up! Swords now only hit a creature once each swing leading to stronger swords in the way the game damages the target, so don't be fooled by lower damage amounts, in some cases they may be stronger!

All the balance details are below, please let me know if I ruined the weapons and need to do more balancing! Spears will most likely be next!

[list]
[*] Renamed Training Sword to Wooden Sword
[*] Wooden Sword Swing Speed 300 -> 270
[*] Steel Sword Swing Speed 340 -> 370
[*] Steel Sword Damage 11 -> 13
[*] Iron Sword Swing Speed 320 -> 300
[*] Iron Sword Damage 15 -> 13
[*] Damascus Sword Swing Speed 300 -> 270
[*] Damascus Sword Damage 17 -> 16
[*] Hero's Blade Knockback  = 4
[*] Wooden Sword Knockback = 4
[*] Damascus Sword Knockback = 7
[*] Iron Sword Knockback = 7
[*] Steel Sword Knockback = 5
[*] Silver Sword Knockback = 8
[/list]

[b]Bugs, Tweaks, Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Lava pits weren't saving properly, this has been fixed
[*] Reduced item drops from wraith (pet/tome)
[*] Mana flower now can be used as an accessory for +5 max mana (stacks up to 3 for +15 max mana)
[*] -20% speed while burning
[/list]

notes.title: The Biome Update & More! Now Out!
notes.notes:
The focus of this update is mainly biomes. However, more than just that has been added, such as a complete rework to the lich boss. Images/gifs below.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Complete lich rework
[*] Lich staff rework (may be a bit OP right now, probably needs a nerf)
[*] Boss health bars added.
[*] New Biome: Tundra
[*] New Biome: Desert
[*] New Biome: Toxic Caves (can generate on any cave level)
[*] Cactus & Cactus juice (the quenchiest)
[*] Desert winds (appears when in desert)
[*] New Creature: Tumbleweed Tumbler, spawns in desert
[*] New Creature: Ice Tumbler, spawns in Tundra
[*] New Creature: Wisps (spawn in desert/toxic caves/lich underworld)
[*] New Creature: Desert Speeder (spawns in desert, can't move, basically a turret)
[*] Mini speeder worms, spawn in Desert after the nest has been defeated
[*] New Structure: Desert/Ice Chests. Obtainable by finding buried treasure in their respective biomes.
[*] Snowy Spruce Trees (Tundra)
[*] Bricks smeltable from mud
[*] New Structure: Brick Furnace, faster than stone furnace, slower than mana furnace.
[*] Occasional snowmen generate in Tundra, also craftable from snow.
[*] New Structure: Toxic Stalagmites. They give off toxic gases that can harm the player(spawn in Toxic Caves)
[/list]

[b]Minor[/b]
[list]
[*] Wraith tome buffed
[*] Sword in rock texture remade
[*] water barrel shadow resized
[*] packed snow couldn't be placed (Fixed)
[*] decreased  cauldron place requirement
[*] Pickaxe structure priority should get things on top of floors before floors now.
[*] Speeder fang drop rate decreased
[*] Life steal for speeder fang/blood bag decreased
[*] The Nest health and damage increased.
[*] Ore gen increased in lich underworld.
[*] Speeder boss movement refined a bit.
[*] Blight from Purple shrooms reduced significantly.
[*] Exit ladder duplication fixed.
[*] Sinkholes are non-reusable again, for some reason they weren't vanishing after a use.
[*] Dropped items when breaking a furnace weren't being networked properly. Fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 0.9.4e
notes.notes:
I'm working on a boss rework for the lich to make it more exciting and adding some cool biomes to the overworld, but for now here are some cool bug fixes :)

- Crafting tool tip moved to a more convenient spot.
- Mana turret no longer targets invincible targets
- Projectiles have local particles making it easier to defer their hitboxes.
- The lich staff has been redone and fires these fire like particles which will be implemented in the new lich boss coming soon.

notes.title: Update Notes for 0.9.4d
notes.notes:
I'm working on another major update alongside a bunch of polish of already existing features, unfortunately, I'm a student and I have been quite busy, however I wanted to get a small patch out with some features.

[list]
[*] Snow appears when snowing
[*] Snow can be crafted into a Packed Snow Block
[*] Packed Snow can be crafted into a Packed Ice block
[*] A Snow Bottle which can be smelted into a water bottle cus science.
[*] ManaStorage targeting fixed where it would target lower priorities but not the lowest first.
[*] Several minor/major bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 0.9.4c
notes.notes: Quick patch to fix a missing inventory bug.

notes.title: Update Notes for 0.9.4b
notes.notes:
This is quite a big one, with a bunch of features, tweaks and bug fixes.

[b]Major[/b]
[list]
[*] Flow Wand Item - Lets you mouse over mana objects and see their transfer range and priority. (Holding shift to see all nearby priorities/ranges, left/right click to raise/lower priority)
[*] Fire Bat - Spawns near fire pools in caves. Has a chance to give the player the "Ignite" effect.
[*] Liquid Mana Bottle renamed to Purified Mana Potion
[*] Purified Mana Potion now grants 35 mana
[*] Purified Mana Potion Quest
[*] Nightshroom pellet has chance of giving the player the "Blight" effect.
[*] Lightshroom gives the player "Emotional Support" while in its light.
[*] Player hurt sound when the total healing effect from effect s is negative.
[*] When using the flow/communication wand no longer will you be able to damage the objects.
[*] Supercharged Sapphire renamed to Control Crystal
[*] Blank Wands now require control crystals to craft.
[*] Snowball item/projectile, currently unobtainable, but implemented.
[*] Ignite Effect - damages player
[*] Blight Effect - damages player
[*] Emotional Support Effect - heals player
[/list]

[b]Minor[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased scroll speed in world select
[*] Fixed possible missing inventory error
[*] Fixed error where chunk wouldn't generate and remain empty.
[*] Wraith/Bat/Bee pets move faster
[*] Wraith/Bat/Bee pets teleport when far from the player
[*] Spawn particle only occurs when near the player
[*] Fixed mana turrets targeting enemy projectiles.
[*] Chance of event each day/night reduced from 20% to 15% chance
[*] Cauldron place hit box reduced in size
[*] Inventory hotbar searching optimized
[*] Lich staff fixed
[*] Lich staff/lich fireball appearance changed
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 0.9.4
notes.notes:
[b]Info[/b]
This update includes some major changes/optimizations to how worlds are loaded/saved, old worlds will automatically get updated to this format  when you try opening them for the first time. (An automatic backup file will be made just in case). With these changes I managed to get a fairly big world from 40-50 FPS to 300 FPS on my hardware (Ryzen 7 1700/GTX 1060).

[b]Major[/b]
- Holding Shift when mining will force target floors only
- Updated world saving/loading format
- Optimized how chunks get disabled/unloaded/enabled.
- Worlds will get backed up when going to the new format.

Please let me know if you encounter any bugs/issues with this update.
Since release the focus has been bugs/optimization but soon I will be changing the focus to some new features.

notes.title: Update Notes for 0.9.3d
notes.notes:
Was informed that 0.9.3c was causing a bunch of CPU/GPU/Memory issues mainly in the main menu, reverted some changes and hopefully it should be fixed, let me know if it is all good now.

For the next patch I will be optimizing how worlds are saved/loaded via a new format, old worlds will be automatically updated to the new version. This will increase world performance and load times since less objects will be loaded at once.

notes.title: Update Notes for 0.9.3c
notes.notes:
Been working on a dynamic building system, but since it isn't ready I have decided to push an update including a few bug fixes/optimizations.

[b]Minor[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimize mana structures (Mana furnace, Mana storage, Mana Collector, etc)
[*] Reduced the amount of particles mana structures create when a ton of them are on screen
[*] Fabricators will no longer over stack.
[*] Optimized physics checks for interdiction structures. (May make them slightly less accurate, let me know if they create any issues)
[/list]
